 Upgrade Your Phone and Fly to Disney: OPPO Launches Epic 11.11 Maligayang PaskOPPO Sale
 By Nicole Tesorero - November 11, 2026 0 138 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp 
 Your next smartphone upgrade could come with a magical trip to Hong Kong Disneyland as OPPO kicks off its holiday season with the massive 11.11 Maligayang PaskOPPO campaign. Running from November 1 to 13, this Christmas blowout offers shoppers up to ₱8,000 off select devices, exclusive freebies, and a chance to win a luxury vacation worth ₱500,000.
 Huge Discounts on the Reno16 Series, Find X9, and More 
 Tech enthusiasts can score massive savings across OPPO’s official online storefronts on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop. The 11.11 Sale features steep discounts on highly coveted models, including the premium Find X9 and the powerful Reno16 Series. To spread extra holiday cheer, OPPO is bundling these select purchases with exclusive freebies and accessories, making it the absolute best time to clear out your tech wishlist.
 Win a ₱500,000 Luxury Hong Kong Disneyland Getaway 
 The crown jewel of the Maligayang PaskOPPO campaign is an all-expenses-paid dream vacation. OPPO is giving away a five-day, four-night Hong Kong Disneyland getaway worth ₱500,000 each for two lucky winners. The premium package covers travel and accommodations, allowing winners to experience the magic of Disney firsthand.
 1,277 Winners to Share Massive Holiday Prize Pool 
 The excitement doesn’t stop at the grand prize. OPPO’s holiday raffle will reward a total of 1,277 grand raffle winners with an incredible lineup of prizes, including:
 • Brand-new smartphones to keep you connected
 • Premium tech accessories to upgrade your daily gear
 • Shopping vouchers for your holiday retail therapy
 • Two luxury Hong Kong Disneyland trips
 Don’t miss your chance to upgrade your mobile experience and score the ultimate holiday travel ticket. Head over to OPPO’s official Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop stores before November 13 to secure your discounts and enter the grand raffle!
